name: TRMNL client (16-grey PNG)
description: Composition PNG fitted to the device's panel size, then quantised to a 16-level greyscale PNG with the selected dither. For TRMNL BYOS panels that paint real greys rather than 1-bit black/white: jailbroken e-readers running KOReader (confirmed on a Kobo Clara HD; Kindle Paperwhite expected to behave the same), and the Seeed reTerminal E1003 / TRMNL X 16-level waveform under TRMNL firmware, which is untested. Output is an 8-bit greyscale PNG using 16 distinct levels, or a true 4-bit greyscale PNG (colour type 0) for a kind that sets png_bit_depth 4 in its protocol_config, as the TRMNL X does; a client that can only paint 1-bit should stay on trmnl_png. Per-device picture quality (dither / contrast) lives on the device card.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
